summary_md: **鄰家橘貓🐱剪輯師 ([@rj_sensei_](https://x.com/rj_sensei_/status/2116430489477324915))** built a skill that mines long livestreams (transcript, chat and volume) for highlight candidates, lets Claude suggest clips, then exports vertical shorts, horizontal rough cuts, SRT and Premiere XML; in follow-ups he invites feedback and notes it only does the rough cut, with post-production still manual ([rightstar2015/stream-highlights-pipeline](https://github.com/rightstar2015/stream-highlights-pipeline)).
